description:
Mark messages in a channel as read up to a specific timestamp.

Updates YOUR read position, not the bot's. Pass the ts of the last message you've
read. For private channels/DMs, set include_private=true.

channel.description: Channel — channel ID (C... / D... for DMs) or #channel-name

ts.description: Timestamp to mark as read up to — input key is ts (not thread_ts or timestamp). Use ts_slack from a message.

name: mark_slack_channel_as_read
